storeRecommendationImages.label: A：お店の人が選ぶおすすめ
storeRecommendationImages.prompt: Use case: ads-marketing. Asset type: background photo for the existing KAGO/App 'store recommendations' card. Primary request: create ONE new image conveying a friendly store recommending everyday groceries, usable for any product category. Reference image role: composition, brightness and friendly photographic mood only; do not copy identities. Scene: A friendly fictional Japanese supermarket staff member wearing a simple teal apron stands behind a clean grocery counter at the right side, warmly presenting a small basket of varied everyday groceries including vegetables, apples, a bread loaf and a blank milk carton. Softly blurred supermarket shelves in the background. A welcoming neighborhood store atmosphere, candid natural smile, realistic approachable lifestyle photography. Composition: landscape 3:2. Keep the left 40 percent softly lit, pale off-white/mint and uncluttered, with no main subjects there, for existing application text. Put all people and the main grocery basket in the right half, faces and groceries comfortably inside the frame. Colors: gentle natural whites, fresh greens, subtle teal accents. Lighting: bright soft daylight. Constraints: image asset only, no words, labels, signs, numbers, logos, typography, prices, discounts, badge graphics, frames, buttons, UI, watermarks, brand packaging or collages. No single product hero shot. Preserve the warm familiar and approachable feel of the original.
